description_html:
VEIKK Creator VK1060


Enjoy a smooth, natural photo editing or drawing experience through the 10x6 inch matte surface workspace. You can easily edit photos and sketches with 16384 levels of pressure sensitivity battery-free pen and 8 customizable shortcut keys.


Super Efficient: 8 customized shortcut keys. With its blind spot reduction design, you can find the position of your shortcut keys efficiently. You can program for your favorite keyboard shortcuts, like zoom in/out, brush size +/-, undo, etc., which can improve efficiency and create a highly ergonomic and convenient work platform. You can keep keyboard use to a minimum while working.


Big Size, Big Experience: Features a 10x6-inch large active drawing area with a papery texture surface, provides smooth and natural photo editng or drawing experience for your digital artwork creation. The USB-C port allows plug in and out with either direction, which is more convenient and stable.


Natural and Precise: The drawing tablet features 16384 levels of pressure sensitivity pen, which makes the lines transition from thin to thick will be fluid and precisely under your control. ±60° Tilt makes a digital stylus draw as natural as a real pencil. It is suitable for sketching, shading as well as creating stylized paintings. The battery-free pen does not need to charge or replace the battery. Create fluently at any time and no need to worry about whether the battery will run out.


To the platform your love: Compatible with Windows 7 or later, macOS 10.12 or later, Linux, and Android 6.0 or later phone (Check Android FAQs first to see if your phone supported) with the OTG connector. You can use it on most creating programs, such as Photoshop, Krita, Illustrator, SAI, SketchBook Pro, Fire Alpaca, Open Canvas, Manga Studio, ibisPaint, Medibang and so on.


Write, Draw, Clip, Sign: Designed for drawing, painting, designing, sketching, E-signatures, gameplay etc. It is also an ideal tool for Online Teaching & Learning and Web conferences & Live broadcasts.


Natural and Precise

Creator VK1060 drawing tablet features a 16384 levels of pressure sensitivity battery-free pen , which makes the lines transition from thin to thick will be fluid and precisely under your control.


Big Size, Big

 

Experience

Creator VK1060 pen tablet features a 10x6-inch large active drawing area with a clean matte surface, provides smooth and natural drawing experience for your digital artwork creation.


Slim and lightweight Design

At just 9mm thickness and 571g net weight, VK1060 is easy to carry and comfortable for extended drawing sessions.

Super Efficient

Creator VK1060 drawing tablet has 8 customized shortcut keys. With its blind spot reduction design, you can find the position of your shortcut keys efficiently. You can program for your favorite keyboard shortcuts, like zoom in/out, brush size +/-, undo, etc., which can improve efficiency and create a highly ergonomic and convenient work platform.


Continuous, Hassle-Free Drawing

The VK1060 pen is battery-free, allowing you to draw continuously without interruptions or charging. Two programmable side buttons give quick access to shortcuts like Eraser or Undo, keeping your workflow fast, smooth, and intuitive so you can focus fully on your creative ideas.


Write, Draw, Clip, Sign

Creator VK1060 Graphics Pen Tablet is designed for drawing, painting, designing, sketching, NFT art, E-signatures, gameplay etc.

It is also an ideal tool for Online Teaching & Learning and Web conferences & Live broadcasts.


Stay Prepared and Organized

The VK1060 comes with 28 replacement nibs to maintain consistent pen performance and precise strokes over time.

Its included pen holder keeps your stylus and nibs secure while protecting your workspace, letting you focus entirely on creating without distractions.


Flexible and Compatible

The USB-C port allows plug in and out with either direction, which is more convenient and stable.


System Compatibility

Works with Windows 7 or later, macOS 10.12 or later, Linux, and Android 6.0 or later.


Creative Software Support

Compatible with creative software including Photoshop, Illustrator, Krita, SAI, SketchBook, FireAlpaca, OpenCanvas, Manga Studio, ibisPaint, MediBang Paint, and more.


What’s In The Box

1× VK1060 Tablet

1× P05 Battery-Free Stylus

1× USB-A to USB-C Cable

28× P05 Replacement Nibs

1× Nib Extractor

1×Pen Pocket

1× Pen Holder

1× Quick Start Guide

1 x Driver Download Card

description_html_ar:
استمتع بتجربة سلسة وطبيعية للرسم مع جرافيك تابلت VEIKK VK1060  بمقاس 10×6 بوصة. 

مع 8 مفاتيح اختصار قابلة للتخصيص يُمكنك برمجتها وفقاً لاحتياجاتك، مثل التكبير/التصغير، وتغيير حجم الفرشاة، والتراجع، وغيرها، مما يُحسّن الكفاءة ويُوفر بيئة عمل مريحة للغاية


ارسم بدقة مع قلم لا يحتاج إلى بطارية أو شحن للعمل، يدعم 16 ألف مستوى من مستويات حساسية الضغط، مع ±60° من حساسية الإمالة. 

الرسم بالقلم طبيعيًا تمامًا كالرسم بالقلم الرصاص، فهو مناسب للرسم والتظليل، مما يتيح لك الإبداع بسلاسة.


يتوافق الجهاز اللوحي بأنظمة التشغيل : 

Windows 10 أو أحدث

Mac OS X 10.12 أو أحدث 

Linux

 Android 6.0 أو أحدث 


يمكنك تشغيل تابلت الرسم مع البرامج الرئيسية مثل :  

Photoshop وKrita وIllustrator وSAI وSketchBook Pro وFire Alpaca وOpen Canvas وManga Studio وibisPaint وMedibang وغيرها.


محتويات العلبة

1x جرافيك تابلت 

1x قلم بدون بطارية 

28 x سنون

1× USB-A to USB-C Cable

1 x Nib Extractor 

1×Pen Pocket

1× Pen Holder

1 x دليل التشغيل 

1 x Driver Download Card
